selected_decision.what_happened: Noah Schochet announced financing including a $100 million Series A to expand TerraFirma technical and construction teams and its semi-autonomous equipment, scaling its existing model of building technology and performing construction jobs.
selected_decision.owner_evidence: Company release names Schochet CEO; his own public financing post commits funds to deployments; Inc. directly interviews him on the business model.
selected_decision.alternative_available: Operate as a technology supplier to other contractors, a market route documented by Inc.; the chosen contractor model already existed before the financing.
selected_decision.ai_nexus: AI planning software and supervised robotic heavy equipment are developed together with field operations.
selected_decision.texas_consequence: Buda technical and field teams can expand; Texas customers would need evidence that automated earthworks improve delivered projects. Hiring and savings are not treated as realized.
selected_decision.next_check: Check the founder-stated end-of-October 2026 fleet deployment goal. Then seek completed Texas job cost, schedule and intervention records; this second check is editorial, with no invented publication date.

evidence_for: Funding supports both equipment development and the field teams that generate practical feedback.
A real Buda facility grounds the expansion in Texas.
evidence_against: Human backup remains part of the system.
Sources do not establish independently measured Texas job savings or safety improvements.
analysis.structural_read: Owning the construction contract tightens the feedback loop and concentrates delivery obligations in the same company.
analysis.forward_implication: Fleet deployment and repeat customer outcomes should test operational progress; capital raised does not establish execution quality.
analysis.conflict_screen_note: No payment, sponsorship or editorial relationship was supplied or identified. Investor and economic-development statements are treated as interested evidence; no investment recommendation or public-policy endorsement.

verified_facts.claim: Schochet is TerraFirma CEO and cofounder; the July 14th, 2026 announcement includes a $100 million Series A.
Funds are intended for engineering, manufacturing, operations, construction and semi-autonomous systems.
The Buda headquarters opened July 10th, 2026, with research, design, testing and outdoor trial space.
TerraFirma describes AI preconstruction software, a remote center and converted heavy equipment.
North Austin, Spicewood and New Braunfels projects are reported by the company, not independently audited here.
Inc. directly interviewed Schochet about performing construction with internal technology and retaining human backup.
Technology supply to other contractors is an available market model; Inc. describes remote equipment vendors alongside TerraFirma.
Inc. identifies field data benefits and the burden of managing crews, machinery and deadlines.
Schochet states a target for fleets on three continents by the end of October 2026; achievement is unverified.
None of the reviewed pages supplies a complete independent Texas job comparison covering final cost, schedule, safety and interventions.

gate_evidence.named_subject: CEO/cofounder identity corroborated by company release and independent interview.
gate_evidence.recent_decision: Financing announcement is 51 days before run; no older strategy adoption is misdated as new.
gate_evidence.decision_owner: Personal financing statement plus CEO interview, not title alone.
gate_evidence.texas_ai_consequence: Buda facility and named Central Texas field work connect AI robotics to local construction.
gate_evidence.primary_source: Complete release and public owner post were fetched this run.
gate_evidence.independent_corroboration: Inc. conducts its own interview. Reprints and investor statements do not count.
gate_evidence.position_or_accountability_read: Mixed execution assessment separates feedback benefits from project-delivery risk and evidence gaps.
gate_evidence.not_recent_repeat: Fetched run history contains only Joydeep Biswas on September 2; no Schochet subject or decision match.
gate_evidence.conflict_clear: No known editorial conflict; interested claims labelled explicitly.
gate_evidence.political_neutrality: Private financing/operations story; no electoral or policy advocacy or ranking.

challenge_pass: Current title supported in fetched sources; no contradictory role change found in current search.

October goal attributed to founder and explicitly not treated as delivery proof.
Full project outcome comparison absent from fetched corpus, rather than a claim none exists anywhere.
